# Synthetic DOCX reading fixture

`template-reading.synthetic.docx` is test-only data authored for the template-reading public component seam. It contains an invitation paragraph, an identical completion paragraph inside a table cell, and the repeated completion paragraph after the table. It proves that actual Mammoth conversion plus current native source metadata distinguishes table/body identities and exposes all linked input markers. It is not a competition template or evidence of Word layout fidelity.
